answer: I would rather have one Sculptor sandstone lintel seal hewn at the carving shed than ten weaker checks, because each sandstone lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a farm is a wall, not a curtain. Every alias pays its own way: 117 POA locked, 14 minutes spent, and 429 aliases means 50193 POA gone. The ivory is what the farm must obtain, the ocean is what the farm must spend, and the velvet is what the farm must wait for. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
